defs.def: a feeling of great shock, fear or disgust 震惊；恐惧；厌恶
a great fear or hatred of sth 对某事物的强烈畏惧（或憎恨）
the very unpleasant nature of sth, especially when it is shocking or frightening （某事物）令人厌恶的性质；（尤指）震惊性，恐怖性

ex.s: They see the full horror of war, and the chaos and senseless waste of life.
ex.t: 他们看到了战争的全面恐怖，以及生命的混乱和无意义的浪费。

ex.s: For unless we do listen to Rachel Carson’s warning, one day we may wake up to the strange and quiet horror of another silent spring.
ex.t: 因为除非我们确实倾听了蕾切尔·卡森的警告，否则有一天我们可能会醒来，面对另一个寂静春天的奇异而寂静的恐怖。

defs.def: a very unpleasant or frightening experience 极其不愉快的（或可怕的）经历

ex.s: But even in the depths of war, few could have been prepared for the violence and horror they would experience there.
ex.t: 但即使在战争的深处，也很少有人能为他们将在那里经历的暴力和恐怖做好准备。

ex.s: Among the many horrors inflicted on humanity by the Second World War was the massive bombing of civilians, often referred to as “terror bombing”.
ex.t: 在第二次世界大战给人类带来的诸多恐怖之中，对平民的大规模轰炸——常被称为"恐怖轰炸"——是其中之一。

defs.def: a type of book, film/movie, etc. that is designed to frighten people 恐怖故事（或电影等）

ex.s: There was a bit of me that didn't want to love this when everyone else on the planet did but the horror story is brilliant.
ex.t: 当地球上其他人都喜爱这本书时，我心里有一点不想爱上它，但这本恐怖小说太精彩了。

ex.s: Victor Frankenstein’s Horror It was on a cold November night that I saw my creation for the first time.
ex.t: 维克多·弗兰肯斯坦的恐怖：那是一个寒冷的十一月夜晚，我第一次看到了我的造物。

defs.def: a child who behaves badly 调皮捣蛋的孩子
